scope: Explicitly restore exported research annotations for further local editing; no automatic load, export, registration, stage renewal or approval
compatibility: Keep editor export and mask-editor-v1 protocol unchanged. Reuse mask-draft-import-v1 strict verification; add detached polygons to the verified result without changing existing review, PNG or count semantics

inputs.current_target: First explicitly load the existing binding JSON and target PNG through the original bounded verification path
inputs.restore_files: Then explicitly select draft JSON and the two matching L8 masks; press the button labelled as replacing current annotations
inputs.bounds: JSON nonempty <=512KiB UTF8, depth<=32; each PNG <=4MiB; native1024x1024, existing64 polygons/128 vertices per polygon/4096 total; check File sizes before reads
inputs.validation: All current five stage fields, target PNG, exact JSON schema and closed flags, raw PNG SHA/bytes, CRC, grayscale decoding, polygon pixel equivalence and counts must match through validateMaskDraft
inputs.ownership: Return separately owned polygon points before any await; asynchronous caller mutation must not change restored annotations

lifecycle.start: The replacement button explicitly clears current polygons, pending points, reviewer fields and prepared downloads while retaining the verified current target image; do not partially mix old and imported annotations
lifecycle.success: Atomically install verified polygons, rebuild native masks/overlay, restore declared record metadata and counters. Do not mark prepared, download or send a request; the user must continue editing or explicitly prepare a fresh snapshot
lifecycle.failure: Keep current target image but leave empty polygons, metadata and no eligible downloads; report failure without auto-fixing inputs
lifecycle.selection: Selecting restore files alone never applies annotations. File changes invalidate outstanding restore/export work; the explicit replacement action is required
lifecycle.async: Use current operation epoch and owned stage/target/file identities before installing. Invalidate on changed input, manual edits, clear, new target or pagehide. Obsolete finally/completion must not clear or populate a newer operation
lifecycle.editing: Disable annotation and export controls during owned restore work, keep explicit clear available, and block canvas handlers as well as buttons
lifecycle.persistence: No localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies, automatic restore or remote file upload

acceptance.unit: Existing strict import/export regressions, detached polygon result and mutation after first await; no change to old export format
acceptance.browser: Installed Chrome/Edge with synthetic target and fixed software graphics: load actual editor, explicit restore, exact native counts, edit restored annotation and export, independent saved PNG/draft comparison, mismatched stage/flag/pixels refusal, changed selection/clear during delayed reads, stale old completion after newer success, pagehide cleanup
acceptance.limits: Synthetic operation and native mask agreement do not prove manual mask correctness, observed skin quality, real service/display, licensed independent evaluation or G3
